_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_double_nonland_mana.py. t_nonland_doubler is Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy's first line alone ('whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one mana of any type that permanent produced'); t_land_doubler is the same sentence about a land, Vorinclex's half, kept here so the shared static is shown to be unregressed rather than only Kinnan's half tested; t_turn_kinnan gates the nonland half on is_your_turn so the condition is shown to be asked; t_bicolor_rock taps for {U} or {B}, a nonland source with a choice, so the doubling is shown to follow what it produced rather than a fixed colour; t_green_four_drop costs {G}{G}{G}{G}, castable off two mana dorks only with the doubling.
